candidates.description: This vector activates strongly for the Thai consonant letter "ม" (mo ma) in various contexts, including isolated characters, tone-marked variations, syllable combinations, and Latin 'M' equivalents.
This vector represents common Thai nominalizing prefixes, suffixes, and morphemes associated with abstract nouns and processes.
This feature vector activates on common Thai conjunctions, prepositions, and grammatical particles used to connect words and phrases.
This vector activates on common Thai script characters, functional words, and subword tokens.
This vector represents a collection of sub-word character fragments, phonetic syllables, and foreign script characters frequently occurring in names and text segmentation artifacts.
This feature vector activates strongly on tokens related to robots, automation, and robotic technology across multiple languages.
This feature vector activates strongly for the letter 'B'/'b' and its phonetic equivalents across different writing systems.
This feature vector represents character strings containing the phonetic sequence "ar" or phonetically similar vowel-liquid combinations across multiple writing systems.
This vector activates strongly for tokens related to robots, robotics, and artificial intelligence.
The tokens represent the concept of robots and mechanical automation.
